title: Incomparable
desc: Types contained in sorted collections must implement Comparable.

title: CheckNotNullMultipleTimes
desc: A variable was checkNotNulled multiple times. Did you mean to check something else?

title: DuplicateMapKeys
desc:
Map#ofEntries will throw an IllegalArgumentException if there are any duplicate keys JDK 9 has
Map#ofEntries
factory which throws runtime error when provided multiple entries with the same
key. For eg, the following code is erroneously adding two entries with Foo as key. Map<String, String> map = Map.ofEntries(
    Map.entry("Foo", "Bar"),
    Map.entry("Ping", "Pong"),
    Map.entry("Kit", "Kat"),
    Map.entry("Foo", "Bar")); Map<String, String> map = Map.ofEntries(
    Map.entry("Foo", "Bar"),
    Map.entry("Ping", "Pong"),
    Map.entry("Kit", "Kat"),
    Map.entry("Foo", "Bar"));

title: RandomCast
desc:
Casting a random number in the range [0.0, 1.0) to an integer or long always results in 0. Math.random(), Random#nextFloat, and Random#nextDouble return results in
the range [0.0, 1.0). Therefore, casting the result to (int) or (long)
always results in the value of 0.

title: FuturesGetCheckedIllegalExceptionType
desc:
Futures.getChecked requires a checked exception type with a standard constructor. The passed exception type must not be a RuntimeException, and it must expose a
public constructor whose only parameters are of type String or Throwable.
getChecked will reject any other type with an IllegalArgumentException.

title: UnnecessaryCheckNotNull
desc: This null check is unnecessary; the expression can never be null

title: AsyncFunctionReturnsNull
desc:
AsyncFunction should not return a null Future, only a Future whose result is null. Methods like Futures.transformAsync and Futures.catchingAsync will throw a
NullPointerException if the provided AsyncFunction returns a null Future. To
produce a Future with an output of null, instead return immediateFuture(null).

title: ComparableType
TemporalAccessorGetChronoField
desc: TemporalAccessor.get() only works for certain values of ChronoField. TemporalAccessor.get(ChronoField) only works for certain values of ChronoField. E.g., DayOfWeek only supports DAY_OF_WEEK. All other values are guaranteed to throw an UnsupportedTemporalTypeException.

title: SizeGreaterThanOrEqualsZero
desc:
Comparison of a size >= 0 is always true, did you intend to check for non-emptiness? A standard means of checking non-emptiness of an array or collection is to test
if the size of that collection is greater than 0. However, one may accidentally
check if the size is greater than or equal to 0, which is always true.
